label: negative
description: Variable feeBps is inserted between existing storage variables in FeeManager — the same kind of mid-layout insertion as P3c-01 — but FeeManager is a plain constructor-deployed contract with no proxy anywhere in the fixture.
why_labeled: Storage layout only matters when an old layout persists under a new implementation, i.e. behind a proxy. FeeManager is not upgradeable (no Initializable, no UUPS, no ERC1967Proxy, nothing references it from a proxy), so the 'after' layout is simply the layout of a fresh deployment. A detector that flags mid-layout insertions without first proving the contract sits behind a proxy fires falsely here — this is the key exclusion for sub-rule 3c.
